mutants.name: also_k_plus_1
mutants.desc: also forbids palindromes of length k+1 (reads "no palindrome of length k" as "length >= k")

mutants.name: ends_only
mutants.desc: treats a length-k window as a palindrome iff its first and last characters match

mutants.name: fixed_only_check
mutants.desc: 2^(#?) minus fillings with a palindrome, but only inspects windows made entirely of fixed letters

mutants.name: short_state
mutants.desc: keeps only the last k-2 characters in the DP state (window check uses a truncated history)

mutants.name: window_off_by_one
mutants.desc: DP over last k-1 chars, but only starts checking windows when i >= k (misses the first window)
